nitroxanalyser.changelog: Shows the complete setup Wi-Fi SSID and password on the Nitrox display by wrapping values onto additional rows instead of truncating them.

divesoftadapter.changelog: Detects the printer model and the loaded label roll, then prints at the correct size and resolution automatically. Fixes labels printing at two-thirds size on 300 DPI printers. Label size is no longer chosen by hand; only orientation, which is remembered when you change roll.
